claims.text: Identifiable student work must not be shared with public AI tools, including personal paid accounts. University-SSO Copilot has a separate enterprise-protection context.

evidence.quote: Privacy and Data security : Student work that can identify, or reasonably be linked to, an individual student is personal information under Ontario's Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (FIPPA) and must be handled accordingly.  Information Security's Artificial Intelligence Acceptable Use Guideline  (May 2026) notes that identifiable student work is confidential information and cannot be shared in public AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini), whether the account is free or a paid personal one. Prompts in those tools have left the University's custody and may train someone's next model. If a teaching/assessment task needs an external tool, you should strip the prompt of any identifying information, ask Information Security to review the tool (if not previously reviewed;  infosec@uoguelph.ca ), or build the task so students enter their own work themselves (while offering them an opt-out).
evidence.title: Teaching and learning with generative AI this fall — Sep 3, 2026 OTL memo

claims.text: Identifiable student work must not be shared with public AI tools, including personal paid accounts. University-SSO Copilot has a separate enterprise-protection context.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot, signed in with your University single sign-on, can be used for student information. Authenticated Copilot runs inside the University's Microsoft environment with enterprise data protection ( Copilot: Get Started ). Faculty and staff use various tools for other purposes, such as drafting, brainstorming, summarizing public material, and that is fine; but do not share student information with third-party tools. For more information, please review the  Information Security guidelines for differentiation among data types .

claims.text: Submitting AI-completed material without instructor permission may constitute academic misconduct. AI detection tools are not approved to support an integrity allegation.

evidence.quote: Academic Integrity : Ensuring students are learning with integrity can be challenging in the age of AI. The calendar's  existing academic misconduct provisions  (Unauthorized Aids and Assistance) cover unauthorized use of AI. Being explicit about your expectations regarding AI use in individual assessments and having students declare sources and prompts for AI use can be helpful promoting a culture of integrity. Use of  tools for detecting AI  use are not approved at Guelph and cannot be used to support an allegation of a breach of academic integrity. Continue to talk with your students and consider ways of re-designing assessments that maximize learning while minimizing opportunities for integrity breaches. This  question guide  may be helpful for engaging in those conversations regarding suspected misuse of Generative AI.

academic_integrity:local-guelph-detector.text: Submitting AI-completed material without instructor permission may constitute academic misconduct. AI detection tools are not approved to support an integrity allegation.
academic_integrity:local-guelph-detector.scope: Current educator guidance strengthens the older provisional detector wording; no automatic finding or penalty is inferred.

evidence.quote: Academic Integrity : Ensuring students are learning with integrity can be challenging in the age of AI. The calendar's  existing academic misconduct provisions  (Unauthorized Aids and Assistance) cover unauthorized use of AI. Being explicit about your expectations regarding AI use in individual assessments and having students declare sources and prompts for AI use can be helpful promoting a culture of integrity. Use of  tools for detecting AI  use are not approved at Guelph and cannot be used to support an allegation of a breach of academic integrity. Continue to talk with your students and consider ways of re-designing assessments that maximize learning while minimizing opportunities for integrity breaches. This  question guide  may be helpful for engaging in those conversations regarding suspected misuse of Generative AI.

teaching_guidance:local-guelph-grading.text: Substantive academic evaluations should never be made independently by AI; grades remain a human decision requiring instructor discretion.
teaching_guidance:local-guelph-grading.scope: September 2026 educator guidance uses “should never”; do not strengthen it to “must never”.

evidence.quote: Using AI for assessment : Substantive academic evaluations should never be made independently by AI: a grade is a human decision at this University and Senate-approved grading procedures require the exercise of discretion by instructors.

coursework.en: Check the syllabus or ask the instructor before using GenAI. Instructors determine whether and how it is incorporated into a course.
coursework.zh: 使用生成式 AI 前先查教学大纲或询问教师，由教师确定是否及如何将其纳入课程。
coursework.meaningEn: Course and assessment scope; account access does not override instructor permission.
coursework.meaningZh: 限课程及考核范围；账户访问不覆盖教师许可条件。

exams.en: Exam permission must be checked with the instructor and assessment instructions; this review does not establish a universal exam rule.
exams.zh: 考试许可须按教师及考核说明确认；本次没有核实通用考试规则。
exams.meaningEn: The course-permission framework does not by itself permit GenAI in an exam.
exams.meaningZh: 课程许可框架本身不代表考试允许使用生成式 AI。

disclosure.en: Students are responsible for appropriately referencing AI use when permitted; the course’s exact disclosure format must be checked.
disclosure.zh: 获准使用 AI 时，学生有责任适当标注其使用；具体披露格式须查课程要求。
disclosure.meaningEn: The 2023 statement and current course guidance; no universal prompt-log format is established.
disclosure.meaningZh: 2023 年声明及当前课程指导；未确立通用提示词记录格式。

privacy_data.en: Identifiable student work must not be shared with public AI tools, including personal paid accounts. University-SSO Copilot has a separate enterprise-protection context.
privacy_data.zh: 可识别的学生作品不得分享给公开 AI 工具，包括个人付费账户；大学 SSO 登录的 Copilot 另有企业数据保护情境。
privacy_data.meaningEn: September 2026 teaching guidance; the replacement Acceptable Use Guideline PDF remains unavailable, so its full data-class rules are not asserted.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 2026 年 9 月教学指引；新版可接受使用指南 PDF 尚未取得，不断言其完整数据分类细则。

approved_tools.en: Use university single sign-on for institutionally protected Copilot access. This is distinct from consumer accounts and from course permission.
approved_tools.zh: 使用大学单点登录进入享有机构保护的 Copilot；这与消费者账户及课程许可均不同。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Institutional authentication context; individual entitlement and vendor retention settings were not independently tested.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 机构身份验证情境；未独立测试个人资格或供应商留存设置。

research_publication.en: The reviewed teaching and library sources do not establish a complete research or thesis AI-use policy.
research_publication.zh: 本次教学与图书馆来源不足以确定完整科研或学位论文 AI 使用政策。
research_publication.meaningEn: Research authorship, confidential manuscripts and supervisory requirements need separate evidence.
research_publication.meaningZh: 科研署名、保密稿件及导师要求须有独立证据。

academic_integrity.en: Submitting AI-completed material without instructor permission may constitute academic misconduct. AI detection tools are not approved to support an integrity allegation.
academic_integrity.zh: 未经教师许可提交 AI 完成的材料可能构成学术不端；AI 检测工具不获准用于支持学术诚信指控。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Current educator guidance strengthens the older provisional detector wording; no automatic finding or penalty is inferred.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 当前教师指引比旧暂行检测表述更明确；不推断自动认定或处罚。

teaching_guidance.en: Substantive academic evaluations should never be made independently by AI; grades remain a human decision requiring instructor discretion.
teaching_guidance.zh: 实质性学术评价不应由 AI 独立作出；成绩仍是需要教师裁量的人工作出决定。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: September 2026 educator guidance uses “should never”; do not strengthen it to “must never”.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 2026 年 9 月教师指引使用 should never，不加强为 must never。

security_procurement.en: The university says its AI Acceptable Use Guideline was replaced and approved in June 2026; the new PDF’s complete security and agentic-AI rules remain unverified.
security_procurement.zh: 学校说明新版 AI 可接受使用指南于 2026 年 6 月获批并替换旧版；新 PDF 的完整安全及智能体规则仍未核实。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Index metadata establishes replacement, not the full text. Third-party learning-platform fee conditions must not be generalised to all AI assignments.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 索引元数据仅确认替换，不代表已取得全文；第三方学习平台费用条件不得推广至全部 AI 作业。

scope.en: Use the source-specific audience, assessment and publication limits below. Institution-wide policy review remains PARTIAL.
scope.zh: 请按下列来源的对象、考核及发表范围使用信息，整校政策审核仍为 PARTIAL。

do.en: Check the syllabus or ask your instructor before coursework use.
do.zh: 用于课程作业前先查大纲或询问教师。

dont.en: Do not submit AI-completed material without instructor permission.
dont.zh: 未经教师许可，不得提交 AI 完成的材料。
